audit_whole_model_replay.py.content:
"""Independently audit the matched replay result and publish terminal evidence."""

import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import math
import statistics
import sys
from pathlib import Path


ARCHIVE_SHA = "eba3267649cf74ad6f0a884e640aa363259c557c7cfbeab08c81102c0c69837e"
BASIS_SHA = "67b7f6725e0d36e4487db167137e38e4b7be6826e4daa938d10703931b111625"
ROUTES = ("parallel_four_sequences", "cached_original_32_sequences")
METHODS = {"exact_trace", "compressed_trace", "whole_model_replay"}


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_bytes())


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def check_matrix(result):
    return 0 <= result["maximum_error"] <= 6e-7 and 0 <= result["relative_error"] <= 1e-4


def audit(work, evidence):
    reference = work / "ladder.json.gz"
    basis_path = work / "compression_canonical.safetensors"
    assert digest(reference) == ARCHIVE_SHA == evidence["archive_sha256"]
    assert digest(basis_path) == BASIS_SHA == evidence["canonical_basis_sha256"]
    previous = json.loads(gzip.decompress(reference.read_bytes()))["trial"]
    assert evidence["checkpoint_revision"] == previous["checkpoint_revision"]
    assert evidence["checkpoint_sha256"] == previous["checkpoint_sha256"]
    group = previous["confirmation"]["L1"][12]
    assert evidence["group"] == group["id"] == "confirmation.L1.packing.2.0"
    assert evidence["rewards"] == group["rewards"] and evidence["seed"] == group["batch_seed"]
    total = sum(group["lengths"])
    longest = max(group["lengths"])
    assert total == evidence["scored_tokens"] == 1172 and evidence["replayed_completions"] == 32
    assert longest == evidence["longest_scored_completion"]
    assert math.isfinite(evidence["score_norm"]) and evidence["score_norm"] > 0
    assert 0 <= evidence["basis_fraction"] <= 1.0001
    payload = evidence["persistent_bytes"]
    assert payload["exact_trace"] == 4 * (8960 + 1536) * total
    assert payload["compressed_trace"] == 4 * 64 * total
    assert payload["fixed_basis"] == 4 * 32 * (8960 + 1536)
    cells = 2 * evidence["padded_prompt_tokens"] + longest - 1
    assert payload["parallel_replay_token_ids_and_prompt_mask"] == 4 * 8 * cells
    assert payload["cached_replay_token_ids_and_prompt_mask"] == 32 * 8 * cells
    tested = evidence["qualification"]
    assert tuple(name for name in ROUTES if name in tested) in (ROUTES[:1], ROUTES)
    for candidate in tested.values():
        ids = candidate["candidate_id_mismatch"]
        logits = candidate["support_logit_mismatch"]
        assert 0 <= ids <= logits <= total and 0 <= candidate["input_rows_not_bitwise"] <= total
        assert candidate["qualified"] == (ids == logits == 0 and check_matrix(candidate))
    choice = next((route for route in ROUTES if route in tested and tested[route]["qualified"]), None)
    assert choice == evidence["selected"]
    if choice is not None:
        assert set(evidence["timings"]) == METHODS
    else:
        assert not evidence["timings"]
    n = 0
    for method in evidence["timings"].values():
        rows = method["rounds"]
        assert len(rows) == 3 and all(check_matrix(row) for row in rows)
        assert all(row["elapsed_ms"] > 0 and row["peak_increment_bytes"] >= 0 for row in rows)
        assert method["median_ms"] == statistics.median(row["elapsed_ms"] for row in rows)
        assert method["median_peak_increment_bytes"] == statistics.median(row["peak_increment_bytes"] for row in rows)
        n += len(rows)
    return {"verified_group": group["id"], "verified_token_count": total, "qualified_replay": choice,
            "verified_timed_updates": n, "routes_tested": len(tested)}


def verified_receipt(path):
    record = read(path)
    details = record["details"]
    assert record["status"] == "success" and record["exit_code"] == 0
    assert details["source_before"] == details["source_after"]
    assert details["checks"] and all(row["status"] == "passed" for row in details["checks"])
    return {"run_id": record["run_id"], "status": record["status"], "exit_code": record["exit_code"],
            "receipt_sha256": digest(path), "config_sha256": details["config_sha256"],
            "source_before": details["source_before"], "source_after": details["source_after"],
            "checks": [{key: row[key] for key in ("status", "exit_code", "duration_ms", "log_sha256")}
                       for row in details["checks"]]}


def publish(work, registered, source_hash, target):
    raw = work / "benchmark.json"
    evidence = read(raw)
    independent = read(work / "replay_audit.json")
    assert audit(work, evidence) == independent
    scripts = ("whole_model_replay.py", "audit_whole_model_replay.py", "replay_path_fixture.py", "sampler_score.py",
               "ladder_audit.py", "qwen_external.py", "d20_eval.py", "run_ladder.py", "public_checkpoint_adapter.py")
    sources = {name: {"content": (work / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), "sha256": digest(work / name)}
               for name in scripts}
    assert sources["whole_model_replay.py"]["sha256"] == source_hash
    receipts = {name: verified_receipt(work / (name + ".json")) for name in
                ("qwen-whole-model-replay", "qwen-replay-cache-fixture", "qwen-whole-model-independent-audit")}
    evidence.update({"implementation_basis": "ba231d259fbf649d50a995dda11598ce2daa9289",
                     "registered_protocol": registered, "raw_sha256": digest(raw), "sources": sources,
                     "audit": independent, "dsr": receipts})
    with target.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(evidence, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not __debug__:
        raise RuntimeError("The replay audit requires Python assertions.")
    if sys.argv[1] == "publish":
        publish(Path(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4], Path(sys.argv[5]))
    else:
        base = Path(sys.argv[1])
        inspected = audit(base, read(base / "benchmark.json"))
        with (base / "replay_audit.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8") as out:
            json.dump(inspected, out, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
            out.write("\n")

d20_eval.py.content:
"""Sample fresh paired arithmetic with the pinned D20 checkpoint."""
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from rich.console import Console

from bio_inspired_nanochat.checkpoint_manager import build_model
from bio_inspired_nanochat.common import stable_seed_u64
from bio_inspired_nanochat.engine import Engine
from bio_inspired_nanochat.gpt import GPT
from public_checkpoint_adapter import MODEL_SHA256, TOKENIZER_SHA256
from tasks.gsm8k import extract_answer


LETTERS = "ABCD"


def sha(path):
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


def load_public(root):
    assert sha(root / "checkpoint/model_000700.pt") == MODEL_SHA256
    assert sha(root / "tokenizer/tokenizer.pkl") == TOKENIZER_SHA256
    model, tokenizer, metadata = build_model(root / "checkpoint", 700, torch.device("cuda"), "eval")
    assert isinstance(model, GPT) and (model.config.n_layer, model.config.n_embd) == (20, 1280)
    assert tokenizer.get_vocab_size() == 65536 and metadata["step"] == 700
    return model, tokenizer


def prompt(tokenizer, row, kind):
    question = row["question"]
    if kind == "free":
        text = question + "\n\nKeep any work short. Put the final integer after ####."
    else:
        options = "\n".join(f"{letter}. {value}" for letter, value in zip(LETTERS, row["options"], strict=True))
        text = f"{question}\n\n{options}\n\nAnswer with just the letter."
    conversation = {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": text}, {"role": "assistant", "content": ""}]}
    return tokenizer.render_for_completion(conversation)


def action_tokens(tokenizer, device):
    options = [tokenizer.encode(f" {letter}") for letter in LETTERS]
    assert all(len(row) == 1 for row in options) and len({row[0] for row in options}) == 4
    return torch.tensor([row[0] for row in options], dtype=torch.long, device=device)


def padded(tokenizer, rows, device):
    prompts = [prompt(tokenizer, row, "choice") for row in rows]
    last = [len(row) - 1 for row in prompts]
    width = max(last) + 1
    eos = tokenizer.encode_special("<|assistant_end|>")
    ids = torch.tensor([row + [eos] * (width - len(row)) for row in prompts], dtype=torch.long, device=device)
    return ids, torch.tensor(last, device=device)


def choose(probability, id_string):
    seed = stable_seed_u64(440313, salt=f"d20.arithmetic.choice:{id_string}") % (2**63)
    gen = torch.Generator(device=probability.device).manual_seed(seed)
    return torch.multinomial(probability, 4, replacement=True, generator=gen), seed


def parse_integer(text):
    answer = extract_answer(text)
    if answer is None:
        return None
    try:
        value = Decimal(answer)
        integer = int(value)
        return integer if value == integer else None
    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError, OverflowError):
        return None


def evaluate_free(model, tokenizer, rows, panel):
    engine = Engine(model, tokenizer)
    output = []
    console = Console()
    for position, row in enumerate(rows, 1):
        base = prompt(tokenizer, row, "free")
        seed = stable_seed_u64(440313, salt=f"d20.arithmetic.free:{row['id']}") % (2**63)
        with torch.no_grad(), torch.autocast(device_type="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16):
            ids, mask = engine.generate_batch(base, num_samples=4, max_batch_size=4, max_tokens=96,
                                              temperature=1.0, top_k=50, seed=seed)
        completions = [tokenizer.decode(sequence[len(base):]) for sequence in ids]
        parsed = [parse_integer(response) for response in completions]
        output.append({"id": row["id"], "gold": row["gold"], "parsed": parsed, "seed": seed,
                       "rewards": [int(answer == row["gold"]) for answer in parsed],
                       "lengths": [len(sequence)-len(base) for sequence in ids], "text": completions,
                       "tokens": ids, "masks": mask, "prompt_length": len(base)})
        if position % 8 == 0:
            console.print(f"{panel} free form {position}/{len(rows)} questions, "
                          f"{sum(sum(item['rewards']) for item in output)} correct")
    return output


def evaluate_choice(model, tokenizer, rows):
    output = []
    device = model.get_device()
    labels = action_tokens(tokenizer, device)
    for start in range(0, len(rows), 8):
        batch = rows[start:start+8]
        ids, last = padded(tokenizer, batch, device)
        index = torch.arange(len(batch), device=device)
        with torch.no_grad(), torch.autocast(device_type="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16):
            hidden = model.get_hidden_states(ids)[index, last]
            logits = model.hidden_to_logits(hidden).index_select(1, labels).float()
            probabilities = logits.softmax(-1)
        for row, policy in zip(batch, probabilities, strict=True):
            sampled, seed = choose(policy, row["id"])
            selected = sampled.tolist()
            output.append({"id": row["id"], "label": row["label"], "probabilities": policy.tolist(), "seed": seed,
                           "samples": selected, "rewards": [int(action == row["label"]) for action in selected]})
    return {"label_token_ids": labels.tolist(), "rows": output}


def main(kind, data, data_sha, checkpoint, output, panels):
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    assert sha(data) == data_sha and kind in ("free", "choice")
    model, tokenizer = load_public(checkpoint)
    data = json.loads(data.read_text())["panels"]
    result = {}
    for panel in panels:
        rows = data[panel]
        if kind == "free":
            result[panel] = evaluate_free(model, tokenizer, rows, panel)
        else:
            result[panel] = evaluate_choice(model, tokenizer, rows)
    record = {"checkpoint_sha256": MODEL_SHA256, "panels_sha256": data_sha, "mode": kind,
              "panels": result, "gpu": torch.cuda.get_device_name()}
    with output.open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(record, stream, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    kind, data, data_sha, checkpoint, output, *panels = sys.argv[1:]
    main(kind, Path(data), data_sha, Path(checkpoint), Path(output), panels)

public_checkpoint_adapter.py.content:
"""Check native loading and an identity-initialized synaptic residual on public D20 weights."""
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from rich.console import Console
from torch import nn

from bio_inspired_nanochat.checkpoint_manager import build_model
from bio_inspired_nanochat.gpt import GPT
from bio_inspired_nanochat.synaptic import SynapticConfig, SynapticLinear
from bio_inspired_nanochat.tokenizer import RustBPETokenizer


REVISION = "53b7aa58db3e1c512d121a53f747f9649c15bc55"
MODEL_SHA256 = "cd0762cbae420c25b47033ad0816ff1d5a61910a7e2223dff156945225e105b6"
TOKENIZER_SHA256 = "4c060565a46fe83b49d99005acba796f2a630daa7970eb49f7513b89f9fb40e0"


def sha(path):
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


class SynapticResidual(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, incumbent):
        super().__init__()
        self.incumbent = incumbent
        cfg = SynapticConfig(enable_hebbian=True, enable_stdp=False, enable_presyn=False, enable_metabolism=False)
        self.adaptation = SynapticLinear(incumbent.in_features, incumbent.out_features,
                                         cfg, bias=False, use_input_ln=False).to(incumbent.weight)
        self.register_buffer("calcium", torch.tensor(0.5, device=incumbent.weight.device))
        self.register_buffer("energy", torch.tensor(0.8, device=incumbent.weight.device))
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.adaptation.w_slow.zero_()
            self.adaptation.w_fast.zero_()
            self.adaptation.post.fast.zero_()
            self.adaptation.post.slow.zero_()
            self.adaptation.post.U.zero_()
        self.requires_grad_(False)
        self.adaptation.w_slow.requires_grad_(True)

    def forward(self, x):
        result = self.incumbent(x)
        local = self.adaptation(x, self.calcium, self.energy, update_mem=False)
        return result + local.to(result.dtype)


def identity(actual, expected):
    assert actual.get_vocab_size() == expected.get_vocab_size() == 65536
    assert actual.enc._pat_str == expected.enc._pat_str
    assert actual.enc._mergeable_ranks == expected.enc._mergeable_ranks
    assert actual.enc._special_tokens == expected.enc._special_tokens
    return {"bpe_ranks": len(actual.enc._mergeable_ranks), "special_tokens": len(actual.enc._special_tokens)}


def logits_and_grad(model, inputs, parameter, enable_autocast, actions=None):
    with torch.autocast(device_type="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16, enabled=enable_autocast):
        logits = model(inputs)[:, -1].float()
        if actions is None:
            actions = logits.detach().topk(2, dim=-1).indices
        sampled = logits.log_softmax(dim=-1).gather(1, actions)
        score = (sampled[:, 0] - sampled[:, 1]).mean() / 2
    return logits.detach(), actions, torch.autograd.grad(score, parameter)[0].detach()


def main(root, tokenizer_path, output):
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    paths = root / "checkpoint"
    assert sha(paths / "model_000700.pt") == MODEL_SHA256
    assert sha(root / "tokenizer/tokenizer.pkl") == TOKENIZER_SHA256
    model, tokenizer, meta = build_model(paths, 700, torch.device("cuda"), "eval")
    assert isinstance(model, GPT) and model.config.n_layer == 20 and model.config.n_embd == 1280
    token_map = identity(tokenizer, RustBPETokenizer.from_directory(tokenizer_path))
    rotary = model.cos, model.sin
    model.float()
    # The production trunk requires its original BF16 rotary tables even
    # when the model parameters and matmuls are tested in FP32.
    model.cos, model.sin = rotary
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    model.requires_grad_(False)
    layer = model.transformer.h[-1].mlp
    archived = layer.c_proj
    device = torch.device("cuda")
    inputs = torch.randint(0, 65528, (2, 32), device=device, generator=torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(44031))
    checks = {}
    for dtype, low_precision in (("fp32", False), ("bf16", True)):
        layer.c_proj = archived
        archived.weight.requires_grad_(True)
        baseline, actions, expected = logits_and_grad(model, inputs, archived.weight, low_precision)
        layer.c_proj = SynapticResidual(archived)
        adaptation = layer.c_proj.adaptation
        adapted, _, result = logits_and_grad(model, inputs, adaptation.w_slow, low_precision, actions)
        torch.testing.assert_close(adapted, baseline, atol=0, rtol=0)
        # Matmul and Linear use transposed parameter layouts at the two
        # sites. Compare after returning to the same orientation.
        torch.testing.assert_close(result, expected.T, atol=2e-5 if low_precision else 3e-7,
                                   rtol=.02 if low_precision else 1e-5)
        assert torch.count_nonzero(adaptation.w_slow) == 0 and expected.norm() > 0
        checks[dtype] = {"logits_identical": True, "gradient_max_difference": float((result - expected.T).abs().max()),
                         "gradient_relative_error": float((result - expected.T).norm() / expected.norm())}
    report = {"artifact_revision": REVISION, "model_sha256": MODEL_SHA256, "tokenizer_sha256": TOKENIZER_SHA256,
              "local_token_map_identical": token_map, "strict_native_load": True, "stored_step": meta["step"],
              "device": torch.cuda.get_device_name(), "contexts": list(inputs.shape), "numeric_checks": checks}
    Console().print(report)
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(*(Path(value) for value in sys.argv[1:]))

qwen_external.py.content:
"""Run the sealed free-form panels on the pinned external arithmetic reference."""
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from rich.console import Console
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

from bio_inspired_nanochat.common import stable_seed_u64
from d20_eval import parse_integer, sha


REVISION = "aafeb0fc6f22cbf0eaeed126eff8be45b0360a35"
LFS_SHA = "08faf1e950173bb44c11d26df28c55da7237dc55c77dbc1cbae4a5d7584540d9"
REQUIRED = ("config.json", "generation_config.json", "tokenizer.json", "tokenizer_config.json",
            "vocab.json", "merges.txt", "LICENSE")


def verify(directory, manifest):
    evidence = json.loads(manifest.read_bytes())
    assert evidence["sha"] == REVISION and evidence["cardData"]["license"] == "apache-2.0"
    indexed = {row["rfilename"]: row for row in evidence["siblings"]}
    weights = directory / "model.safetensors"
    assert weights.stat().st_size == 3087467144
    assert sha(weights) == LFS_SHA == indexed["model.safetensors"]["lfs"]["sha256"]
    fingerprints = {}
    for name in REQUIRED:
        content = (directory / name).read_bytes()
        header = f"blob {len(content)}\0".encode()
        assert hashlib.sha1(header + content, usedforsecurity=False).hexdigest() == indexed[name]["blobId"]
        fingerprints[name] = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
    return fingerprints


def evaluate(model, tokenizer, rows, panel):
    console = Console()
    output = []
    for offset in range(0, len(rows), 16):
        batch = rows[offset:offset+16]
        texts = []
        for row in batch:
            content = row["question"] + "\n\nKeep any work short. Put the final integer after ####."
            texts.append(tokenizer.apply_chat_template([{"role": "user", "content": content}],
                                                       tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True))
        encoded = tokenizer(texts, add_special_tokens=False, padding=True, return_tensors="pt").to("cuda")
        width = encoded["input_ids"].size(1)
        seed = stable_seed_u64(440313, salt=f"external.qwen.free:{panel}:{offset}") % (2**63)
        torch.manual_seed(seed)
        torch.cuda.manual_seed(seed)
        with torch.inference_mode():
            tokens = model.generate(**encoded, max_new_tokens=96, do_sample=True, temperature=1.0,
                                    top_k=50, top_p=1.0, repetition_penalty=1.0, num_return_sequences=4,
                                    pad_token_id=tokenizer.pad_token_id)
        stop = model.generation_config.eos_token_id
        endings = set(stop if isinstance(stop, list) else [stop])
        endings.add(tokenizer.pad_token_id)
        for index, row in enumerate(batch):
            prompt = encoded["input_ids"][index][encoded["attention_mask"][index].bool()].tolist()
            completion = []
            for sequence in tokens[index*4:(index+1)*4, width:].tolist():
                end = next((pos for pos, value in enumerate(sequence) if value in endings), len(sequence))
                completion.append(sequence[:end])
            decoded = tokenizer.batch_decode(completion, skip_special_tokens=True)
            parsed = [parse_integer(response) for response in decoded]
            output.append({"id": row["id"], "gold": row["gold"], "parsed": parsed, "seed": seed,
                           "rewards": [int(answer == row["gold"]) for answer in parsed],
                           "lengths": [len(seq) for seq in completion], "text": decoded,
                           "tokens": [prompt + seq for seq in completion], "prompt_length": len(prompt),
                           "masks": [[0] * len(prompt) + [1] * len(seq) for seq in completion]})
        console.print(f"{panel} external reference {len(output)}/32, {sum(sum(row['rewards']) for row in output)} correct")
    return output


def main(data_path, fingerprint, directory, manifest, output):
    assert sha(data_path) == fingerprint
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    identity = verify(directory, manifest)
    cuda_device = torch.device("cuda:0")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(directory, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False)
    tokenizer.padding_side = "left"
    assert tokenizer.pad_token_id is not None and tokenizer.chat_template
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(directory, dtype=torch.bfloat16, local_files_only=True,
                                                trust_remote_code=False, use_safetensors=True).to(cuda_device).eval()
    assert model.config.model_type == "qwen2" and 1_000_000_000 < model.num_parameters() < 2_000_000_000
    rows = json.loads(data_path.read_bytes())["panels"]
    scores = {panel: evaluate(model, tokenizer, rows[panel], panel) for panel in ("screen", "confirmation")}
    evidence = {"mode": "free", "panels": scores, "panels_sha256": fingerprint, "checkpoint_sha256": LFS_SHA,
                "model_revision": REVISION, "input_file_sha256": identity, "model_parameters": model.num_parameters(),
                "gpu": torch.cuda.get_device_name()}
    with output.open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(evidence, stream, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    path, fingerprint, directory, manifest, output = sys.argv[1:]
    main(Path(path), fingerprint, Path(directory), Path(manifest), Path(output))

replay_path_fixture.py.content:
"""Check the manual cached replay against generation on left-padded Qwen states."""

import torch
from rich.console import Console
from transformers import Qwen2Config, Qwen2ForCausalLM

from whole_model_replay import GROUP_INDEX, cached, describe


def main():
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    torch.manual_seed(811029)
    model = Qwen2ForCausalLM(Qwen2Config(vocab_size=64, hidden_size=32, intermediate_size=64,
                                        num_hidden_layers=2, num_attention_heads=4,
                                        num_key_value_heads=2, pad_token_id=0, eos_token_id=None)).eval()
    model.requires_grad_(False)
    input_ids = torch.arange(3, 43).reshape(8, 5)
    input_ids[::2, :2] = 0
    attention = (input_ids != 0).to(torch.long)
    block = model.model.layers[-1]
    start = GROUP_INDEX * 4
    group = slice(start, start + 4)
    inputs, hidden = [], []

    def trace_input(_, args):
        inputs.append(args[0][group, -1].clone())

    def trace_residual(_, _args, output):
        hidden.append(output[group, -1].clone())

    handles = (block.mlp.down_proj.register_forward_pre_hook(trace_input), block.register_forward_hook(trace_residual))
    try:
        with torch.inference_mode():
            result = model.generate(input_ids, attention_mask=attention, do_sample=True, temperature=1.0, top_k=50,
                                    top_p=1.0, num_return_sequences=4, max_new_tokens=8, return_dict_in_generate=True,
                                    output_scores=True)
    finally:
        for handle in handles:
            handle.remove()
    width = input_ids.shape[1]
    row = torch.arange(4).repeat_interleave(8)
    step = torch.arange(8).repeat(4)
    targets = result.sequences[group, width:].flatten()
    expected_x = torch.stack(inputs)[step, row].float()
    expected_r = torch.stack(hidden)[step, row]
    observed, expected_feedback = describe(model, expected_r, [part[group] for part in result.scores],
                                           row, step, targets, already_masked=True)
    padded = torch.cat((attention.repeat_interleave(4, dim=0), attention.new_ones((32, 7))), dim=-1)
    positional = (padded.cumsum(-1) - 1).masked_fill(padded == 0, 0)
    data = {"sequences": result.sequences[:, :-1], "attention": padded, "position_ids": positional,
            "prompt_width": width, "samples": row, "steps": step, "targets": targets, "lengths": [8] * 4}
    x, feedback, support = cached(model, data)
    assert support == observed
    torch.testing.assert_close(x, expected_x, rtol=0, atol=0)
    torch.testing.assert_close(feedback, expected_feedback, rtol=0, atol=0)
    Console().print({"scored_actions": len(support), "supports_equal": True, "feedback_equal": True})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not __debug__:
        raise RuntimeError("The fixture requires Python assertions.")
    main()

run_ladder.py.content:
"""Screen the sealed ladder, then evaluate only the selected confirmation band."""
import json
import re
import sys
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from rich.console import Console
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

from bio_inspired_nanochat.common import stable_seed_u64
from ladder_audit import check_panels, choose_level, fingerprint, score
from qwen_external import LFS_SHA, REVISION, verify


SYSTEM_PROMPT = r"Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed{}."
CANDIDATE = re.compile(r"\\boxed\s*\{([^{}]*)\}")
INTEGER_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[+-]?[0-9]+(?:,[0-9]{3})*(?:\.[0-9]+)?")


def numerical_box(text):
    for candidate in reversed(CANDIDATE.findall(text)):
        payload = candidate.strip()
        if INTEGER_PATTERN.fullmatch(payload):
            val = Decimal(payload.replace(",", ""))
            if val == int(val):
                return int(val)
    return None


def batch_decode(model, tokenizer, group, panel, level, offset):
    device = model.device
    texts = [tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
        [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT}, {"role": "user", "content": row["question"]}],
        tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True) for row in group]
    prefixes = tokenizer(texts, add_special_tokens=False, padding=True, return_tensors="pt").to(device)
    width = prefixes["input_ids"].shape[1]
    seed = stable_seed_u64(811024, salt=f"ladder.{panel}.{level}.{offset}") % (2**63)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    torch.cuda.manual_seed(seed)
    with torch.inference_mode():
        sequences = model.generate(**prefixes, max_new_tokens=512, do_sample=True, temperature=1.0,
                                   top_k=50, top_p=1.0, repetition_penalty=1.0, num_return_sequences=4,
                                   pad_token_id=tokenizer.pad_token_id)
    ids = sequences[:, width:].tolist()
    assert len(ids) == len(group) * 4
    eos = model.generation_config.eos_token_id
    end_ids = set(eos if isinstance(eos, list) else [eos]) | {tokenizer.pad_token_id}
    output = []
    for index, row in enumerate(group):
        tokens = prefixes["input_ids"][index][prefixes["attention_mask"][index].bool()].tolist()
        tails = []
        for seq in ids[4*index:4*(index+1)]:
            end = next((i for i, value in enumerate(seq) if value in end_ids), len(seq))
            tails.append(seq[:end])
        text = tokenizer.batch_decode(tails, skip_special_tokens=True)
        answers = [numerical_box(value) for value in text]
        output.append({"id": row["id"], "gold": row["gold"], "answers": answers, "text": text,
                       "rewards": [int(answer == row["gold"]) for answer in answers],
                       "tokens": [tokens + tail for tail in tails], "masks": [[0] * len(tokens) + [1] * len(tail) for tail in tails],
                       "lengths": list(map(len, tails)), "prompt_length": len(tokens), "batch_seed": seed})
    return output


def eval_rows(model, tokenizer, rows, panel, level):
    console = Console()
    emitted = []
    for start in range(0, len(rows), 8):
        emitted.extend(batch_decode(model, tokenizer, rows[start:start+8], panel, level, start))
        correct = sum(sum(row["rewards"]) for row in emitted)
        mixed = sum(0 < sum(row["rewards"]) < 4 for row in emitted)
        n = len(emitted)
        console.print(f"{panel} {level} {n}/{len(rows)} questions  |  {correct}/{4*n} correct  |  {mixed}/{n} mixed")
    return emitted


def save(path, result):
    with path.open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(result, stream, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")


def main(panel_file, panel_sha, checkpoint, manifest, output):
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    assert fingerprint(panel_file) == panel_sha
    panels = json.loads(panel_file.read_bytes())["panels"]
    assert check_panels(panels) == 192
    hashes = verify(checkpoint, manifest)
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(checkpoint, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False)
    tokenizer.padding_side = "left"
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(checkpoint, dtype=torch.bfloat16, local_files_only=True,
                                                trust_remote_code=False, use_safetensors=True).to("cuda").eval()
    assert model.config.model_type == "qwen2" and model.num_parameters() == 1543714304
    screening, confirmation = {}, {}
    for level in ("L1", "L2", "L3"):
        screening[level] = eval_rows(model, tokenizer, panels["screen"][level], "screen", level)
        # Keep rows from every completed stratum even if a later check is interrupted.
        save(output.parent / f"screen-{level}.json", screening[level])
    selected, decisions = choose_level(panels, screening)
    save(output.parent / "selected.json", {"level": selected, "screening_gates": decisions, "panels_sha256": panel_sha})
    if selected is not None:
        confirmation[selected] = eval_rows(model, tokenizer, panels["confirmation"][selected], "confirmation", selected)
        Console().print({"selected": selected, "confirmation": score(panels["confirmation"][selected], confirmation[selected])})
    save(output, {"screen": screening, "confirmation": confirmation, "panels_sha256": panel_sha,
                  "checkpoint_sha256": LFS_SHA, "checkpoint_revision": REVISION,
                  "gpu": torch.cuda.get_device_name(), "model_parameters": model.num_parameters(),
                  "checkpoint_files": hashes, "selected_level": selected})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    panel, sha, checkpoint, manifest, output = sys.argv[1:]
    main(Path(panel), sha, Path(checkpoint), Path(manifest), Path(output))

sampler_score.py.content:
"""Check the delayed score on the support used by one real Qwen generation batch."""

import gzip
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import transformers
from rich.console import Console
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from transformers.generation.logits_process import TopKLogitsWarper

from ladder_audit import fingerprint, last_box
from qwen_external import LFS_SHA, REVISION, verify
from run_ladder import SYSTEM_PROMPT


TOP_K = 50
CHUNK = 64
RELATIVE_BOUND = 1e-4
ABSOLUTE_BOUND = 6e-7


def unpack_support(raw, masked, action, k=TOP_K):
    cutoff = raw.kthvalue(raw.numel() - k + 1).values
    keep = raw >= cutoff
    torch.testing.assert_close(keep, torch.isfinite(masked), atol=0, rtol=0)
    ids = torch.where(keep)[0]
    logits = masked[ids]
    torch.testing.assert_close(logits, raw[ids], atol=0, rtol=0)
    matches = torch.where(ids == action)[0]
    assert len(matches) == 1
    probability = logits.softmax(-1)
    error = (probability - masked.softmax(-1)[ids]).abs().max()
    assert float(error) <= 1e-6
    return ids, logits, int(matches[0]), float(cutoff), float(error)


def analytical_feedback(hidden, scale, eps, selected_head, logits, actions):
    probabilities = logits.softmax(-1)
    chosen = selected_head[torch.arange(len(actions), device=actions.device), actions]
    expectation = torch.bmm(probabilities.unsqueeze(1), selected_head).squeeze(1)
    q = (chosen - expectation) * scale
    rms = (hidden.square().mean(-1, keepdim=True) + eps).sqrt()
    return (q - hidden * (hidden * q).mean(-1, keepdim=True) / rms.square()) / rms


def independent_gradient(parameter, states, hidden, scale, eps, head, primal, actions, coefficients, denominator):
    width = (hidden.shape[-1],)
    before = F.rms_norm(hidden, width, scale, eps)
    perturbed = F.rms_norm(hidden + states @ parameter, width, scale, eps)
    logits = primal + torch.bmm(head, (perturbed - before).unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
    loss = (logits.log_softmax(-1).gather(1, actions[:, None]).flatten() * coefficients).sum() / denominator
    derivative, = torch.autograd.grad(loss, parameter)
    return derivative, float(loss.detach())


def fixed_support_score(states, hidden, model_head, model_scale, eps, support, weights):
    device = states.device
    n = len(support)
    labels = torch.tensor([item[2] for item in support], device=device)
    weight = torch.tensor(weights, device=device)
    width = max(len(item[0]) for item in support)
    token_ids = torch.zeros((n, width), dtype=torch.long, device=device)
    logits = torch.full((n, width), -torch.inf, device=device)
    for index, (ids, supported, _, _, _) in enumerate(support):
        token_ids[index, :len(ids)] = ids
        logits[index, :len(ids)] = supported
    parameter = torch.zeros((states.shape[-1], hidden.shape[-1]), dtype=torch.float64,
                            device=device, requires_grad=True)
    local_inputs = states.float()
    residual = hidden.float()
    scale = model_scale.float()
    oracle = torch.zeros_like(parameter, requires_grad=False)
    feedback = []
    loss = 0.0
    for first in range(0, n, CHUNK):
        window = slice(first, first + CHUNK)
        head = model_head[token_ids[window]].float()
        feedback.append(analytical_feedback(residual[window], scale, eps, head, logits[window], labels[window]))
        reference, value = independent_gradient(
            parameter, local_inputs[window].double(), residual[window].double(), scale.double(), eps,
            head.double(), logits[window].double(), labels[window], weight[window].double(), n,
        )
        oracle.add_(reference)
        loss += value
    trace = torch.cat(feedback)
    local = (local_inputs.T @ (trace * weight[:, None]) / n).double()
    return compare(local, oracle, loss)


def compare(local, oracle, loss):
    denominator = float(oracle.norm())
    assert denominator > 0
    relative = float((local - oracle).norm()) / denominator
    maximum = float((local - oracle).abs().max())
    assert relative <= RELATIVE_BOUND and maximum <= ABSOLUTE_BOUND
    return {"gradient_relative_error": relative, "gradient_max_error": maximum,
            "gradient_norm": denominator, "objective": loss, "matrix_shape": list(local.shape)}


def fixture():
    raw = torch.tensor([2.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0, -3.0])
    sample = 3
    masked = TopKLogitsWarper(2)(torch.empty((1, 1), dtype=torch.long), raw[None, :])[0]
    witness = unpack_support(raw, masked, sample, 2)
    assert witness[0].tolist() == [0, 1, 2, 3]
    assert witness[2] == 3 and witness[3] == 1.0
    planted_loss = masked.clone()
    planted_loss[3] = -torch.inf
    try:
        unpack_support(raw, planted_loss, sample, 2)
    except AssertionError:
        dropped_tie_rejected = True
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Dropping a boundary tie unexpectedly passed")
    states = torch.tensor([[0.7, 0.2], [0.1, 0.6]])
    hidden = torch.tensor([[0.4, 0.2, -0.5], [0.6, -0.6, 0.2]])
    head = torch.arange(18).reshape(6, 3).float().cos()
    scale = torch.tensor([1.0, 0.8, 0.6])
    return {"tied_support_ids": witness[0].tolist(), "dropped_tie_rejected": dropped_tie_rejected,
            "score": fixed_support_score(states, hidden, head, scale, 1e-6, [witness, witness], [0.5, -0.5])}


def generate(model, tokenizer, batch, seed, chosen):
    device = model.device
    prompts = [tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
        [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT}, {"role": "user", "content": row["question"]}],
        tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True,
    ) for row in batch]
    encoded = tokenizer(prompts, add_special_tokens=False, padding=True, return_tensors="pt").to(device)
    start = 4 * chosen
    rows = slice(start, start + 4)
    states, hidden, logits = [], [], []
    block = model.model.layers[-1]

    def capture_states(_module, inputs):
        states.append(inputs[0][rows, -1].clone())

    def capture_hidden(_module, _inputs, output):
        hidden.append(output[rows, -1].clone())

    def capture_logits(_module, _inputs, output):
        logits.append(output[rows, -1].clone())

    hooks = [block.mlp.down_proj.register_forward_pre_hook(capture_states),
             block.register_forward_hook(capture_hidden), model.lm_head.register_forward_hook(capture_logits)]
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    torch.cuda.manual_seed(seed)
    try:
        with torch.inference_mode():
            result = model.generate(
                **encoded, max_new_tokens=512, do_sample=True, temperature=1.0, top_k=TOP_K,
                top_p=1.0, repetition_penalty=1.0, num_return_sequences=4, pad_token_id=tokenizer.pad_token_id,
                return_dict_in_generate=True, output_scores=True,
            )
    finally:
        for hook in hooks:
            hook.remove()
    return encoded, result, states, hidden, logits


def replay(model, tokenizer, sealed, trial):
    previous = trial["confirmation"]["L1"]
    chosen = next(index for index, row in enumerate(previous) if 0 < sum(row["rewards"]) < 4)
    batch_start = chosen // 8 * 8
    slot = chosen - batch_start
    batch = sealed["panels"]["confirmation"]["L1"][batch_start:batch_start + 8]
    prior_batch = previous[batch_start:batch_start + 8]
    observed = previous[chosen]
    seed = observed["batch_seed"]
    encoded, result, states, hidden, raw = generate(model, tokenizer, batch, seed, slot)
    end_token_ids = model.generation_config.eos_token_id
    stops = set(end_token_ids if isinstance(end_token_ids, list) else [end_token_ids])
    stops.add(tokenizer.pad_token_id)
    ends = result.sequences[:, encoded.input_ids.shape[1]:].tolist()
    assert len(states) == len(hidden) == len(raw) == len(result.scores) == len(ends[0])
    trimmed = [tokens[:next((index for index, value in enumerate(tokens) if value in stops), len(tokens))]
               for tokens in ends]
    for index, item in enumerate(prior_batch):
        original_prompt = encoded.input_ids[index][encoded.attention_mask[index].bool()].tolist()
        assert all(original_prompt + tokens == before
                   for tokens, before in zip(trimmed[4 * index:4 * index + 4], item["tokens"], strict=True))
    tokens = trimmed[slot * 4:slot * 4 + 4]
    rewards = [int(last_box(text) == observed["gold"]) for text in tokenizer.batch_decode(tokens, skip_special_tokens=True)]
    assert rewards == observed["rewards"]
    rows = []
    pre, post, support, mass = [], [], [], []
    average = sum(rewards) / len(rewards)
    for index, sequence in enumerate(tokens):
        for step, action in enumerate(sequence):
            pre.append(states[step][index].clone())
            post.append(hidden[step][index].clone())
            item = unpack_support(raw[step][index].float(), result.scores[step][slot * 4 + index], action)
            support.append(item)
            mass.append(rewards[index] - average)
            rows.append({"sample": index, "position": step, "action": action, "support_ids": item[0].tolist(),
                         "support_logits": item[1].tolist(), "cutoff": item[3], "probability_error": item[4]})
    del result, states, hidden, raw
    ordered = torch.stack(pre), torch.stack(post)
    # Use regular tensors for autograd because the generation states were saved in inference mode.
    head = model.lm_head.weight.detach()
    norm = model.model.norm
    score = fixed_support_score(*ordered, head, norm.weight.detach(), norm.variance_epsilon, support, mass)
    return {"group": observed["id"], "replayed_questions": len(batch), "replayed_completions": len(trimmed),
            "seed": seed, "rewards": rewards, "scored_tokens": len(rows), "score": score, "support": rows}


def main(checkpoint, manifest, archive, archive_sha, output):
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    integrity = fixture()
    console = Console()
    console.print("Boundary-tie fixture passed. Loading the pinned Qwen checkpoint.")
    assert fingerprint(archive) == archive_sha
    study = json.loads(gzip.decompress(archive.read_bytes()))
    assert study["frozen_qualified_setting"]["level"] == "L1"
    assert study["trial"]["checkpoint_sha256"] == LFS_SHA
    verify(checkpoint, manifest)
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(checkpoint, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False)
    tokenizer.padding_side = "left"
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(checkpoint, dtype=torch.bfloat16, local_files_only=True,
                                                trust_remote_code=False, use_safetensors=True).to("cuda").eval()
    model.requires_grad_(False)
    assert model.config.model_type == "qwen2" and model.num_parameters() == 1543714304
    result = replay(model, tokenizer, study["panels"], study["trial"])
    console.print({name: result[name] for name in ("group", "replayed_completions", "scored_tokens", "score")})
    result.update({"fixture": integrity, "checkpoint_sha256": LFS_SHA, "checkpoint_revision": REVISION,
                   "archive_sha256": archive_sha, "torch_version": str(torch.__version__),
                   "transformers_version": transformers.__version__, "gpu": torch.cuda.get_device_name()})
    with output.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(result, stream, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":"))
        stream.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not __debug__:
        raise RuntimeError("The fixed-support study requires Python assertions.")
    main(Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2]), Path(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4], Path(sys.argv[5]))

whole_model_replay.py.content:
"""Compare retained Qwen traces with post-reward whole-model replay."""

import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import torch
import transformers
from rich.console import Console
from safetensors.torch import load
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from transformers.cache_utils import DynamicCache

from ladder_audit import fingerprint
from qwen_external import LFS_SHA, REVISION, verify
from sampler_score import analytical_feedback, generate


ARCHIVE_SHA = "eba3267649cf74ad6f0a884e640aa363259c557c7cfbeab08c81102c0c69837e"
BASIS_SHA = "67b7f6725e0d36e4487db167137e38e4b7be6826e4daa938d10703931b111625"
GROUP_INDEX = 4
CHUNK = 64
TOP_K = 50
REPEATS = 3


def logged_rollout(model, tokenizer, questions, observed):
    seed = observed[GROUP_INDEX]["batch_seed"]
    encoded, generated, x, residual, raw = generate(model, tokenizer, questions, seed, GROUP_INDEX)
    width = encoded.input_ids.shape[-1]
    ends = model.generation_config.eos_token_id
    stops = set(ends if isinstance(ends, list) else [ends]) | {tokenizer.pad_token_id}
    tails = generated.sequences[:, width:].tolist()
    trimmed = [row[:next((index for index, token in enumerate(row) if token in stops), len(row))] for row in tails]
    assert len(trimmed) == 32
    base = GROUP_INDEX * 4
    for index, prior in enumerate(observed):
        prefix = encoded.input_ids[index][encoded.attention_mask[index].bool()].tolist()
        assert [prefix + row for row in trimmed[4 * index:4 * index + 4]] == prior["tokens"]
    actions = trimmed[base:base + 4]
    lengths = list(map(len, actions))
    assert sum(lengths) == 1172 and observed[GROUP_INDEX]["id"] == "confirmation.L1.packing.2.0"
    samples = torch.tensor([sample for sample, row in enumerate(actions) for _ in row], device=model.device)
    steps = torch.tensor([index for row in actions for index, _ in enumerate(row)], device=model.device)
    targets = torch.tensor([action for row in actions for action in row], device=model.device)
    retained_input = torch.stack(x[:max(lengths)])[steps, samples]
    retained_residual = torch.stack(residual[:max(lengths)])[steps, samples]
    scores = [value[base:base + 4] for value in generated.scores[:max(lengths)]]
    support, feedback = describe(model, retained_residual, scores, samples, steps, targets, already_masked=True)
    # Also re-create the censoring of each captured distribution from the original logits.
    independently_masked, _ = describe(model, retained_residual, raw[:max(lengths)], samples, steps, targets)
    assert support == independently_masked
    used = width + max(lengths) - 1
    sequences = generated.sequences[:, :used].clone()
    initial_mask = encoded.attention_mask.repeat_interleave(4, dim=0)
    attention = torch.cat([initial_mask, initial_mask.new_ones((len(initial_mask), used - width))], dim=-1)
    position_ids = (attention.cumsum(-1) - 1).masked_fill(attention == 0, 0)
    data = {"sequences": sequences, "attention": attention, "position_ids": position_ids, "prompt_width": width,
            "samples": samples, "steps": steps, "targets": targets, "lengths": lengths,
            "group": observed[GROUP_INDEX]["id"], "seed": seed, "rewards": observed[GROUP_INDEX]["rewards"]}
    return data, retained_input.float(), feedback, support


def describe(model, residual, logits_by_step, sample, step, targets, already_masked=False, record_support=True):
    """Recover every top-k support, including equal scores at its boundary."""
    head = model.lm_head.weight.detach()
    norm = model.model.norm
    records, feedback = [], []
    for first in range(0, len(targets), CHUNK):
        section = slice(first, first + CHUNK)
        if isinstance(logits_by_step, torch.Tensor):
            values = logits_by_step[section].float()
        else:
            index = zip(step[section].tolist(), sample[section].tolist(), strict=True)
            values = torch.stack([logits_by_step[t][row] for t, row in index]).float()
        if not already_masked:
            cutoff = values.topk(TOP_K).values[:, -1:]
            values = values.masked_fill(values < cutoff, -torch.inf)
        counts = values.isfinite().sum(-1)
        candidates = values.topk(int(counts.max()), dim=-1)
        matches = (candidates.indices == targets[section, None]) & candidates.values.isfinite()
        valid = matches.any(-1)
        columns = matches.to(torch.long).argmax(-1)
        # A failed replay can move a sampled action outside its support.
        # Preserve this failure while still measuring reconstructable rows.
        vector = analytical_feedback(residual[section].float(), norm.weight.detach().float(), norm.variance_epsilon,
                                     head[candidates.indices].float(), candidates.values, columns)
        feedback.append(vector.masked_fill(~valid[:, None], 0.0))
        if record_support:
            for ids, scores, count in zip(candidates.indices.tolist(), candidates.values.tolist(), counts.tolist(), strict=True):
                records.append(sorted(zip(ids[:count], scores[:count], strict=True)))
    return records, torch.cat(feedback, dim=0)


def gradient(x, feedback, weights):
    return x.T @ (feedback * weights[:, None]) / len(weights)


def errors(actual, reference):
    delta = actual - reference
    return {"relative_error": float(delta.norm() / reference.norm()), "maximum_error": float(delta.abs().max())}


def qualify(x, feedback, support, expected, weights, exact, trace_input):
    direction = gradient(x, feedback, weights)
    result = errors(direction, exact)
    result["candidate_id_mismatch"] = sum([item[0] for item in left] != [item[0] for item in right]
                                          for left, right in zip(support, expected, strict=True))
    result["support_logit_mismatch"] = sum(left != right for left, right in zip(support, expected, strict=True))
    result["input_rows_not_bitwise"] = int(len(x) - (x == trace_input).all(-1).sum())
    result["qualified"] = (
        result["candidate_id_mismatch"] == 0 and result["support_logit_mismatch"] == 0
        and result["relative_error"] <= 1e-4 and result["maximum_error"] <= 6e-7
    )
    return result


@torch.inference_mode()
def parallel(model, data, record_support=True):
    row = data["samples"]
    lo = GROUP_INDEX * 4
    selected = slice(lo, lo + 4)
    targets = data["targets"]
    positions = data["prompt_width"] - 1 + data["steps"]
    inputs, residual = [], []
    block = model.model.layers[-1]

    def trace_input(_, args):
        inputs.append(args[0][row, positions].clone())

    def trace_residual(_, _args, output):
        residual.append(output[row, positions].clone())

    handles = (block.mlp.down_proj.register_forward_pre_hook(trace_input), block.register_forward_hook(trace_residual))
    try:
        normalized = model.model(
            input_ids=data["sequences"][selected].contiguous(),
            attention_mask=data["attention"][selected].contiguous(),
            position_ids=data["position_ids"][selected].contiguous(),
            use_cache=False,
        ).last_hidden_state[row, positions]
    finally:
        for handle in handles:
            handle.remove()
    logits = torch.cat([model.lm_head(normalized[start:start + CHUNK]) for start in range(0, len(targets), CHUNK)])
    support, feedback = describe(model, residual[0], logits, row, data["steps"], targets, record_support=record_support)
    return inputs[0].float(), feedback, support


@torch.inference_mode()
def cached(model, data, record_support=True):
    block = model.model.layers[-1]
    lo = GROUP_INDEX * 4
    window = slice(lo, lo + 4)
    inputs, residual, logits = [], [], []

    def trace_input(_, args):
        inputs.append(args[0][window, -1].clone())

    def trace_residual(_, _args, output):
        residual.append(output[window, -1].clone())

    handles = (block.mlp.down_proj.register_forward_pre_hook(trace_input), block.register_forward_hook(trace_residual))
    cache = DynamicCache(config=model.config)
    width = data["prompt_width"]
    try:
        for index in range(max(data["lengths"])):
            context = width + index
            kwargs = model.prepare_inputs_for_generation(
                data["sequences"][:, :context], next_sequence_length=1 if index else width,
                attention_mask=data["attention"][:, :context].contiguous(), position_ids=data["position_ids"][:, :context],
                is_first_iteration=index == 0, past_key_values=cache, logits_to_keep=1, use_cache=True,
            )
            out = model(**kwargs, return_dict=True)
            cache = out.past_key_values
            logits.append(out.logits[window, -1].clone())
    finally:
        for handle in handles:
            handle.remove()
    row, step = data["samples"], data["steps"]
    x = torch.stack(inputs)[step, row].float()
    captured = torch.stack(residual)[step, row]
    support, feedback = describe(model, captured, logits, row, step, data["targets"], record_support=record_support)
    return x, feedback, support


def time_once(operation):
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    start_bytes = torch.cuda.memory_allocated()
    torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
    start = time.perf_counter_ns()
    output = operation()
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    return output, {"elapsed_ms": (time.perf_counter_ns() - start) / 1e6,
                    "peak_increment_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() - start_bytes}


def compare_paths(model, data, x, f, reference, frozen):
    console = Console()
    rewards = torch.tensor(data["rewards"], device=model.device, dtype=torch.float32)
    weights = (rewards - rewards.mean())[data["samples"]]
    exact = gradient(x, f, weights)
    left, right = frozen["input"], frozen["feedback"]
    low_x, low_f = x @ left, f @ right
    projected = left.T @ exact @ right
    coordinates = gradient(low_x, low_f, weights)
    coordinate_error = errors(coordinates, projected)
    assert coordinate_error["relative_error"] <= 1e-4
    payload = {"exact_trace": x.numel() * x.element_size() + f.numel() * f.element_size(),
               "compressed_trace": low_x.numel() * low_x.element_size() + low_f.numel() * low_f.element_size(),
               "fixed_basis": sum(tensor.numel() * tensor.element_size() for tensor in frozen.values()),
               "cached_replay_token_ids_and_prompt_mask": (
                   data["sequences"].numel() + data["attention"][:, :data["prompt_width"]].numel()) * 8,
               "parallel_replay_token_ids_and_prompt_mask": (
                   data["sequences"].numel() + data["attention"][:, :data["prompt_width"]].numel())}
    candidates = {"parallel_four_sequences": parallel, "cached_original_32_sequences": cached}
    qualification, selected = {}, None
    for name, route in candidates.items():
        states, feedback, support = route(model, data)
        qualification[name] = qualify(states, feedback, support, reference, weights, exact, x)
        console.print({name: qualification[name]})
        del states, feedback, support
        if qualification[name]["qualified"]:
            selected = name
            break
    results = {"score_norm": float(exact.norm()), "coordinate_error": coordinate_error,
               "basis_fraction": float(coordinates.square().sum() / exact.square().sum()),
               "persistent_bytes": payload, "qualification": qualification, "selected": selected, "timings": {}}
    if selected is None:
        return results

    def replay_update():
        states, feedback, _ = candidates[selected](model, data, record_support=False)
        return gradient(states, feedback, weights)

    methods = {"exact_trace": lambda: gradient(x, f, weights),
               "compressed_trace": lambda: left @ gradient(low_x, low_f, weights) @ right.T,
               "whole_model_replay": replay_update}
    gold = {"exact_trace": exact, "compressed_trace": left @ projected @ right.T, "whole_model_replay": exact}
    names = list(methods)
    for method in names[:2]:
        methods[method]()
    timings = {name: [] for name in names}
    for repeat in range(REPEATS):
        for offset in range(len(names)):
            method = names[(repeat + offset) % len(names)]
            value, measurement = time_once(methods[method])
            checks = errors(value, gold[method])
            assert checks["relative_error"] <= 1e-4 and checks["maximum_error"] <= 6e-7
            timings[method].append({**measurement, **checks})
        console.print(f"Matched round {repeat + 1}/{REPEATS} completed.")
    results["timings"] = {
        method: {"rounds": samples, "median_ms": statistics.median(row["elapsed_ms"] for row in samples),
                 "median_peak_increment_bytes": statistics.median(row["peak_increment_bytes"] for row in samples)}
        for method, samples in timings.items()
    }
    return results


def main(checkpoint, manifest, archive, basis_path, output):
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    assert fingerprint(archive) == ARCHIVE_SHA and fingerprint(basis_path) == BASIS_SHA
    prior = json.loads(gzip.decompress(archive.read_bytes()))
    assert prior["trial"]["checkpoint_sha256"] == LFS_SHA and prior["frozen_qualified_setting"]["level"] == "L1"
    verify(checkpoint, manifest)
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(checkpoint, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False)
    tokenizer.padding_side = "left"
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(checkpoint, dtype=torch.bfloat16, local_files_only=True,
                                                trust_remote_code=False, use_safetensors=True).to("cuda").eval()
    model.requires_grad_(False)
    assert model.num_parameters() == 1543714304
    basis = {name: matrix.cuda() for name, matrix in load(basis_path.read_bytes()).items()}
    assert set(basis) == {"input", "feedback"}
    original = prior["panels"]["panels"]["confirmation"]["L1"][8:]
    observed = prior["trial"]["confirmation"]["L1"][8:]
    data, x, feedback, support = logged_rollout(model, tokenizer, original, observed)
    Console().print(f"Archived generation matched on 32 completions; benchmark scored {len(support)} actions.")
    result = compare_paths(model, data, x, feedback, support, basis)
    result.update({"group": data["group"], "seed": data["seed"], "rewards": data["rewards"],
                   "scored_tokens": len(support), "replayed_completions": 32, "archive_sha256": ARCHIVE_SHA,
                   "canonical_basis_sha256": BASIS_SHA, "checkpoint_sha256": LFS_SHA, "checkpoint_revision": REVISION,
                   "support_sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(support, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest(),
                   "padded_prompt_tokens": data["prompt_width"], "longest_scored_completion": max(data["lengths"]),
                   "torch_version": str(torch.__version__), "transformers_version": transformers.__version__,
                   "gpu": torch.cuda.get_device_name()})
    with output.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(result, stream, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not __debug__:
        raise RuntimeError("The replay benchmark requires Python assertions.")
    main(*(Path(value) for value in sys.argv[1:]))
